title: An average piece of furniture
text:
An average piece of furniture. more difficult to put together than other diy furniture. A few difficult angles and some uncooperative screws. I would attribute it to user error, except that the ones that worked, worked easily. That and I've put together 11 pieces of furniture over the last couple of years, so I'm not new to this.

There's only 4" clearance between shelves, so take that into mind when purchasing. It is what it says it is, a reader's table, and no more. I got the shorter one. I think the taller one would have been a better choice.

product_metadata.title: Brookstone Reader's End Table
features: Designed for corners and small spaces - keeps your reading material organized and easily accessible
